correspondences.notes: MEG FIF only; sidecars are not carried but can be rebuilt from the FIF info (e.g. with mne-bids).

brainlife.desc: Continuous MEG and/or EEG as an MNE-Python Raw object saved in FIF (raw.fif); converted from vendor formats or preprocessed.
brainlife.name: neuro/meeg/mne/raw
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Hub format for M/EEG preprocessing in MNE (filtering, ICA, SSP, epoching, PSD).

**Not for:** Telling raw from preprocessed data without checking datatype tags. BIDS raw export of EEG: BIDS does not accept FIF for EEG.

**BIDS:** meg/meg (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 32 Apps, output of 24 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meeg.mne.raw.json

files.desc: MNE Raw FIF file with data, channel info, annotations and projectors.

identifying_risks: MNE measurement info in the raw FIF can carry subject_info, meas_date and digitised head points.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level M/EEG derivative linkable through a participant code.
sharing_cautions: Run mne anonymize (info) before sharing outside a controlled project.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if the measurement info keeps subject_info (name, birth date) or meas_date.
